verdicts.explanation: The paper states the room-temperature impedance-derived conductivity of ~5×10-4 mS/cm applies to both Li2BaSnS4 and Li2SrSiS4 (Results, Fig.4b discussion), with EIS as the method and solid-state synthesis. The NEB barrier is correctly left out of activation_energy_eV.
The same paper statement covers Li2SrSiS4 (~5×10-4 mS/cm at room temperature by EIS, experimental, solid-state reaction). The 0.34 eV value is an NEB barrier and is correctly left null.

The paper gives a range of 0.016~0.72 mS/cm for the two Cl-doped compounds and does not tie the 0.72 maximum to a specific composition. Assigning a single value to the combined pair is not supported, so the record is unsupported under the strict standard.
